title: London Boat Rentals

services.name: 21' Boat Rental in Long Beach
services.desc: You are your own captain at London Boat Rentals! Our boats reach a cruising speed of 5 miles an hour, very similar to driving a golf cart. 12 PERSON MAXIMUM PER BOAT. (all children and babies included in head count). Please arrive 30 minutes prior to your rental time with your entire party. The boats are very easy to navigate. Upon boarding our vessels, our Dock Master will charter you to the open Bay. Once the dock master reaches the end of the dock, the keys will be handed off to you! You will be given a quick tutorial on how to navigate the vessel, a map of all the sites to see and places to cruise. It's as easy as that! Our boats are always food, drink, and pet friendly! blurb: Guests rent cozy, fully enclosed Duffy boats to cruise Alamitos Bay and the Naples Canals. Boats have a maximum speed of 5 mph and include radios with CD players and auxiliary input. The experience is family and pet friendly, with life jackets provided for all children under 12 and optional add-ons like food, drinks, and party decor.
